notes.title: Ho ho holidays!
notes.content:
[h1]Ho Ho Holidays![/h1]

Jingle bells, fat man smells. It's that time of year, cookies, milk and judgements. We have to do our part for the holidays, and what better way than allowing you to judge Santa Claus!?

[list]
[*] Increased the databank of possibilities for Sins.
[*] Increased the databank of possibilities for Deeds.
[*] Increased the databank of possibilities for Notes.
[*] Santa Claus added!
[*] Santa Claus judgement achievement added.
[/list]
[h2]Minor changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] TURD editor bug not entering into the correct name category has been fixed. 
[*] Overhauled how custom soul sprites are handled, detailed tutorial coming soon. Be sure to check the community forums, Discord or our Twitter for updates on this.

[/list]
Have fun stuffing your faces death lords!

-GX

notes.title: Guy Fawkes Night
notes.content:
[h1]Guy Fawkes Night![/h1]

What type of game would this be, if we didn't include Guy Fawkes into this vichyssoise of verbiage? Dunk this valorous master exploder into the firey puts of P.UR.G.A.T.O.R.Y for the 5th!

[i]Oh and for the achievement.[/i] 

[list]
[*] Increased the databank of possibilities for Sins.
[*] Increased the databank of possibilities for Deeds.
[*] Increased the databank of possibilities for Notes.
[*] Nerfed some of the developer souls spawn rates.
[*] Guy Fawkes added.
[*] Guy Fawkes achievement added.
[/list]

Vivify the skies this evening death lords!

-GX

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Spoopy Holidays![/h1]

It's our favourite day of the year, [b]𝐻𝐴𝐿𝐿𝑂𝑊𝐸𝐸𝑁[/b]! We've added extra treats in this update, check below!

[list]
[*] Increased the databank of possibilities for Sins.
[*] Increased the databank of possibilities for Deeds.
[*] Increased the databank of possibilities for Notes.
[*] Added LooseScrew friends' souls, with a secret in one of them!
[*] This gradual databank increase will now become a biweekly rolling update.
[/list]
[h2]Minor changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sound effects have had their audio levels normalized, better to hear certain ones now. [i]*poop*[/i]
[*] Fixed bug where spells & stats would carry over when starting a new game.
[*] Fixed bug with achievement 'Genders :3'.
[*] Changed the way we internally cast spells resulting in even better game performance.
[*] Normalized the rate of Sins, Deeds and Notes when arriving in bulk.
[*] Achievements not being given when cheats are enabled is not a bug! ːsteammockingː
[/list]
Have fun this evening, death lords!

-GX
